description: Replaces the document-level generatedAt with a string that does not parse and empties the caseStudies list, so src/components/CaseStudies/index.js takes two arms the shipped corpus cannot reach: the shared MirrorSyncStatus it renders at src/components/CaseStudies/index.js:72-73 returns null at src/components/shared/MirrorSyncStatus.js:22 -- the !syncDate arm, for a timestamp that is present but unparseable -- and the '|| []' fallback at src/components/CaseStudies/index.js:48 supplies the list the page filters, counts and maps over. The value is deliberately not JSON null: null is falsy, so the component would return at src/components/shared/MirrorSyncStatus.js:20 first and the src/components/shared/MirrorSyncStatus.js:22 arm would stay unreached by every browser build, which is what it was until this overlay changed shape. The src/components/shared/MirrorSyncStatus.js:20 arm keeps its browser coverage from tests/e2e/fixtures/data-variant/radar-reports.json, which still clears the field outright, so the two overlays hold one arm each rather than both holding the same one. Both fields are document-level on the one file the one /resources/case-studies page reads, so changing them in the ordinary coverage build would not add a case -- it would trade the provenance line and every rendered row for these two arms, including the undated-study rows the additive overlay in tests/e2e/fixtures/data/case-studies.json exists to render. The variant build is served beside the real one, so one Playwright run reaches both and neither displaces the other. Whether the regions also leave the e2e report's uncovered list is a separate question: both builds' generated code maps the branches back to different original coordinates, which is the region-attribution problem tracked in #1066 and #1079. The browser taking the arms is pinned by tests/e2e/case-studies-variant.spec.js regardless.
